note: Adapted from the original description of Silvestri (1914) (misprinted in the original as preterianus, i.e. pretorianus); the original is in Latin and describes only the soldier and worker, not the queen; type locality Pretoria, Transvaal; measurements in mm as in the original.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 6 mm; head length 1.63 mm, width 1.30 mm; mandible length 1.43 mm; antennal length 1.82 mm; hind tibia 1.10 mm. Body creamy white, head pale yellowish white, mandibles black, abdomen grey from the gut contents. Head about 1/4 longer than wide, the posterior corners rounded, the sides nearly parallel, the frons slightly rounded and raised above the fontanelle; labrum slightly widened and deeply concave in the middle, the anterior corners broad, rounded on the inner side and nearly acute on the outer. Mandibles slightly longer than the head width, slightly curved at the tip. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 almost twice as long as segment 3; segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length; segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4. Posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum slightly concave in the middle. Legs sparsely hairy; the inner margin of the tibia of the first pair of legs with shorter and thicker spines, the tibia of the second pair with a stout distal outer spine. Abdominal tergites and sternites with shorter hairs and 3—4 rows of short hairs and a few longer hairs.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body length 4.5 mm; head length 0.80 mm, width 0.95 mm; antennal length 1.25 mm; hind tibia 0.91 mm. Body straw-coloured, head creamy yellow, abdomen grey from the gut contents. Upper surface of the head with shorter hairs and rather many long hairs, clypeus large and well inflated; antennae 15 (14)-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 with a bare basal demarcation and about 1/6 longer than segment 4, segment 5 nearly as long as segment 3. Posterior margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum concave in the middle. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
